name: GravityBall
storyline: Long, long ago, an ancient magical sphere existed on Earth. It was a kind of ancient power of the Earth. But one day, aliens arrived on Earth. They stole the sphere and locked it away on their space base. But the sphere awakened. And now it wants to break free from its imprisonment and protect the Earth from the threat.
summary:
GravityBall is an action-arcade game where players take control of an ancient, magical artifact attempting to escape from deep within a high-tech alien stronghold. Stripped from Earth and locked away for its immense power, the spherical artifact awakens with a single purpose: navigate the alien base's complex defense systems and break free.

Featuring 20 meticulously handcrafted levels rather than procedural generation, the game offers a structured journey with a rising mechanical challenge. Players must roll, dodge, and weave through specialized obstacle courses by mastering and upgrading six unique magical abilities, including Lightning Discharge, Levitation, Time Distortion, Shockwave, and a specialized Wrecking Ball mechanic. Alongside its progression system, GravityBall features distinct unlockable skins to customize the artifact, an original atmospheric soundtrack, and entirely human-made, stylized 3D visuals.
